source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Unopposed nominations from the Derry Journal (20 September 1946, p. 7).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Twenty-four candidates were returned unopposed for the 28 seats, three retiring members were automatically returned in divisions with no nominations, and Lislea, reported in the nominations as a contest, was settled without a poll: the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Strabane Chronicle, 28 September 1946, p. 2) declares Dunn elected there, no poll having been taken. Returned unopposed.
